text:
Type: felt storage baskets, set of four
Use: holding small items on shelves, desks or in drawers; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: soft thick felt, contrasting blanket-stitch edging
Colors: light grey, turquoise, lime green and orange stitching
Shape: four round open bowls in graduated sizes, low straight sides with a vertical seam, colored overcast stitching along the rims and bases, soft, lightweight and nesting
Feel: playful, soft, friendly, tidy
Goes with: white shelves, light wood, grey textiles, pops of color; Scandinavian rooms, home offices and kids' rooms

product.name: KNATTING
product.description: Ideal for storing small things on the desk, hobby beads, and small toys.
